title: Day 3 — AI Se Images Banana: Midjourney aur Ideogram Basics
preamble: AI image generation tools jaise Midjourney aur Ideogram aapko text se realistic, artistic ya unique images banane mein madad karte hain. Bas ek prompt likhna hai, aur AI usko visualize karta hai. Yeh design, marketing, social media aur freelancing ke liye bohat useful hai.

sections.label: Concept
sections.content: AI image generation tools jaise Midjourney aur Ideogram aapko text se realistic, artistic ya unique images banane mein madad karte hain. Bas ek prompt likhna hai, aur AI usko visualize karta hai. Yeh design, marketing, social media aur freelancing ke liye bohat useful hai.

sections.label: Example
sections.content:
Midjourney mein image banane ke liye:
1. Discord server join karo (midjourney.com)
2. `/imagine prompt: a cyberpunk city at night, neon lights, futuristic, highly detailed` likho
3. AI 4 images generate karega, phir aap "Upscale" ya "Variation" kar sakte hain.

sections.label: Practice
sections.content:
Apne Discord mein Midjourney join karo, aur yeh prompt try karo:
`/imagine prompt: a cute corgi dog wearing a chef hat, cooking in a kitchen, cartoon style`

sections.label: Mini Project
sections.content:
Ek 3-image series banayein:
1. "A futuristic office in 2050"
2. "A cozy library with floating books"
3. "A dragon flying over a medieval castle"
Sabko ek-saath save karke ek folder mein rakhein.
